task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Bring the brown sauce can over and set it near the medium-sized teal blue cooking pot
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架将棕色酱罐移过来并放置在中型水鸭蓝色烹饪锅附近
